environments.prompt: Create a production game environment background for SATs Legends, a polished cartoon fantasy maths game for ages 10–13. Wide landscape 16:9 composition, crisp hand painted cel-shaded shapes, strong dark outlines, lush detailed rich colour like a high quality adventure game, not photorealistic. Scene: a spectacular volcanic lava canyon crossing inside a vast basalt cavern. Foreground dark rock ledges at lower left and lower right; midground a wide molten river running from left to right, orange gold currents, lava waterfalls, cracked basalt cliffs, distant volcanic towers and luminous crystals. Depth and adventure, controlled danger, no characters. Keep the middle third of the lava river open and horizontal for interactive stepping platforms we will add in code. Camera wide enough to see the whole environment; no close-up stretched texture. No text, labels, UI, borders, grids, stepping stones or charts. Intended as a full desktop game scene.
